card.title: EXPOSED
card.text: Costs 1 less if you control a US unit. Deal 5 damage to a unit with no combat keywords.
card.flavorText: In the summer of 1944, German Army Group Centre held what was believed to be a strong defensive line in Belarus. However, its position had become dangerously exposed. Hitler expected a Soviet offensive in the south and refused to allow tactical withdrawals, leaving the central front undermanned and vulnerable. On June 22, the Soviets launched Operation Bagration with over two million men. Exploiting weak flanks and gaps in coordination between German units, Soviet forces used overwhelming artillery, armor and air support to punch through enemy defensive lines. German divisions were rapidly encircled and destroyed, unable to retreat or regroup. Entire corps vanished within days. Communications collapsed, and supplies ran out. Towns like Vitebsk, Orsha, and Mogilev fell in quick succession. By mid-July, Army Group Centre had lost around 350,000 men, dead, wounded or captured. This crushing defeat shattered the German front in the east and opened the road to Warsaw. Operation Bagration remains one of the largest and most successful offensives in military history. The exposed heart of the German defense was struck with devastating precision, and it never fully recovered.
